subject: CPPO: Reseller readiness — demo quota, evidence, and co-sell ops
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@cloudresell.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO: Reseller readiness — demo quota, evidence, and co-sell ops

Hi Carlos,

Thanks for the time earlier. We're aiming to get your team into our CPPO co-sell pipeline next week and want to confirm a few operational items so the AWS team can fast-track the private offer activation. Quick items below — can you confirm by EOD Monday?

- Demo quota: you mentioned a weekly cap of 8 demo seats for initial launch. We need to confirm whether those are per-region or global.
- Evidence package: AWS will ask for technical evidence (SOC2 excerpt, KMS details, SSO flow). I've attached the reseller evidence manifest and a short preflight doc with required items.
- Demo environment access: we can provision a sandbox opt-in API key for 30 days; we need primary contacts for entitlement provisioning.
- Pricing redirect: will CloudResell accept our listing SKU mapping or want to propose a split?

Ben, Priyom — looping you in for quota provisioning and entitlement-runbook prep.

Carlos/Jemma — if you can drop primary contact names and confirm region scoping (US/EU), we'll finish the CPPO checklist and send the DocuSign for the reseller-side attestation.

Thanks,
Aisha
Director, Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: reseller_evidence_manifest.xlsx, cpop-preflight-questions.pdf

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@cloudresell.io>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Jemma Lau <jemma@cloudresell.io>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: CPPO: Reseller readiness — demo quota, evidence, and co-sell ops

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the concise list. Quick answers inline.

- Demo quota: 8 seats per account, global for now; if demand spikes we'll carve by region.
- Evidence package: we can provide SOC2 Type II summary and our SOC2 auditor contact. For SSO/KMS, we need a short template from you that lists exactly what AWS expects.
- Demo access: sandbox API key sounds good; primary is me (carlos@cloudresell.io) and Jemma (jemma@cloudresell.io).
- Pricing: we'll accept the SKU mapping but request a 10% delta on reseller margin for the first 90 days to fund co-sell demo credits.

Can you share the entitlement matrix so we can validate provisioning timelines? We'll also need the DocuSign to sign the reseller attestation (legal on our side wants it in place before entitlement).

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@cloudresell.io>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO: Reseller readiness — demo quota, evidence, and co-sell ops

Carlos — adding the entitlement/provisioning details here and attaching the demo_quota_matrix.csv. High level timeline and next steps: 

1) Entitlement provisioning (2 business days)
   - Input needed: primary contact email and AWS account alias for entitlement mapping.
   - Output: provisioned entitlement IDs and test keys (30-day sandbox).

2) Evidence handoff (3–5 business days)
   - We need SOC2 summary + auditor contact + signed attestation (DocuSign).
   - If you can deliver the SOC2 docs to security@redwood.com, I'll route to infra for KMS/SSO questions.

3) Demo quota enforcement (ongoing)
   - Initial enforcement: 8 demo seats per account, global scope.
   - If usage > 70% in a given week, we'll trigger a quota review and auto-burst policy to avoid customer friction.

Attachments: demo_quota_matrix.csv

Requested action: please reply with the two contact emails and confirm whether CloudResell legal will sign the DocuSign below. Once we have that, Aisha will kick the CPPO submission and I will provision entitlements.

Ben Carter
Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@cloudresell.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO: Reseller readiness — demo quota, evidence, and co-sell ops

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround, team. Summary and actions: 

- CloudResell primary contacts: Carlos Mendez (carlos@cloudresell.io), Jemma Lau (jemma@cloudresell.io) — confirmed.
- Demo quota: 8 seats per account (global). Ben will provision sandboxes tomorrow (ETA: Wed 08:30 PT).
- Evidence: Carlos, please send SOC2 summary + auditor contact to security@redwood.com. I've queued the DocuSign; please expect a notification shortly (link below).
- Pricing: Aisha to own margin exception request with sales ops for 90-day promotional delta; expect decision by Thu EOD.

Next steps: Ben to post entitlement IDs in the HubSpot deal record (link below). Aisha will submit CPPO entry to AWS after attestation is signed.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/98765
DocuSign (reseller attestation): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&id=3a9f

Thanks — looking forward to mid-Oct go-live.

Aisha
Director, Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
